fact_text: Direct property ownership means buying a whole asset and handling tenants, maintenance, legal disputes and occupation risk, while a listed REIT gives rental exposure without those tasks and in small units.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Dolmen City REIT Analysis: Better Than Buying Property?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Dolmen City REIT owns two assets: Dolmen Mall Clifton in Karachi and the Harbour Front office building located next to it.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Dolmen City REIT Analysis: Better Than Buying Property?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Dolmen Mall Clifton charges materially higher rent per square foot than other Karachi malls, which the analyst attributes to strong footfall and affluent shoppers that give the mall pricing power.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Dolmen City REIT Analysis: Better Than Buying Property?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Mall pricing power comes from footfall: brands accept higher rents in malls with more affluent visitors, so a strong mall can keep occupancy high even when one tenant leaves.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Dolmen City REIT Analysis: Better Than Buying Property?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The exit of a large tenant such as Car4 from Dolmen Mall Clifton has limited rent impact, because the mall runs high occupancy and other brands queue for vacated space.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Dolmen City REIT Analysis: Better Than Buying Property?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Harbour Front is a multi-tenant office building in which several multinational companies lease space, which the analyst presents as a second income stream beside the mall.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Dolmen City REIT Analysis: Better Than Buying Property?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: At FY25 the weighted average lease expiry (WALE) of Dolmen Mall Clifton was 2.44 years, which the analyst reads as a measure of how long rental income is contracted.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Dolmen City REIT Analysis: Better Than Buying Property?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: At FY25 the weighted average lease expiry (WALE) of Harbour Front was 4.28 years, longer than the mall's, which the analyst sees as a durability strength.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Dolmen City REIT Analysis: Better Than Buying Property?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Property management fees of about 7 to 8% of rent are DCR's largest expense, and the analyst says controlling costs is why profits grow faster than rent.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Dolmen City REIT Analysis: Better Than Buying Property?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst treats profit growth outpacing rent growth, driven by cost control, as a key quality signal for Dolmen City REIT.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Dolmen City REIT Analysis: Better Than Buying Property?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: DCR announces quarterly dividends soon after each quarter closes, before audited accounts are approved a few weeks later, which the analyst reads as an investor-friendly approach.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Dolmen City REIT Analysis: Better Than Buying Property?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: DCR is moving some tenants from fixed rent to a revenue-sharing model in which part of tenant sales flows to the REIT, while most rent remains fixed.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Dolmen City REIT Analysis: Better Than Buying Property?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst sees revenue-sharing as a long-term positive for DCR rather than a near-term gamechanger, since the revenue-linked part of rental income is still small.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Dolmen City REIT Analysis: Better Than Buying Property?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst expects DCR to announce earnings and dividends of roughly PKR 2.75 to 3.0 per share in FY27.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Dolmen City REIT Analysis: Better Than Buying Property?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The stock market values listed rental trusts on dividend yield against bank deposit and savings rates, so falling interest rates tend to raise the fair value of dividend-paying REITs.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Dolmen City REIT Analysis: Better Than Buying Property?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Property is valued on rental yield in the property market, while listed REITs may be valued on dividend yield; the analyst is unsure which basis DCR's price will follow over the coming years.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Dolmen City REIT Analysis: Better Than Buying Property?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: Dolmen Mall Lahore, Dolmen Mall Tariq Road and Dolmen Mall North Nazimabad belong to separate Dolmen group entities, so their performance does not directly change DCR's earnings.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Dolmen City REIT Analysis: Better Than Buying Property?' (YouTube transcript, undated)

fact_text: The analyst's three-step investing framework is to first understand the business, then verify the numbers against audited reports, and only then invest.
source_name: Abdul Rehman Najam, 'Dolmen City REIT Analysis: Better Than Buying Property?' (YouTube transcript, undated)
